real_world.use: The motor turns a crank and a pitman link rocks the walking beam, a four-bar that nods the horsehead up and down.
Each crank and counterweight swings a pitman arm that rocks the beam and strokes the downhole pump.
The crankshaft, connecting rods and pistons turn visibly as each piston slides in its bore.
A cut-away Model T engine runs so the crank, rods and pistons can be seen converting reciprocation to rotation.
A pin on the piston rod slides in a slotted yoke on the output shaft, turning linear piston travel into a quarter-turn valve stroke.
Opposed pistons drive a scotch yoke in place of a crankshaft, so the piston rod moves straight while the crank pin slides in the yoke slot.
The opposed piston pair is joined to a slotted yoke, and a crank pin riding in the slot turns the reciprocating push into rotation.
The two cylinders rock on trunnions while their piston rods drive the paddle crankshaft directly.
The cylinder rocks on its trunnion as the piston rod turns the crank, and the rocking opens and closes the ports.
Five small wobbler engines run, each with a cylinder swinging on a pivot to work its own ports.

real_world.product: Steam locomotive driving wheels with coupling rods
real_world.use: The coupling rod links two crank pins on equal-radius wheels, so both wheels turn full circles at the same speed as a parallel double-crank linkage.

real_world.product: Steam locomotive driving wheels with coupling rods (running, close up)
real_world.use: The side rod ties the crank pins of the coupled wheels together so they rotate in step while the loco moves.

real_world.product: Bristol Dockside level luffing crane No. 29
real_world.use: The jib and its rocking links swing so the hook stays level while the load is luffed in and out.
Two parallelogram arms keep the lamp head at the same angle as it is moved, balanced by a spring.
A chain of parallelogram arms lets the lamp head reach and hold positions without tilting.

real_world.product: DESTACO manual toggle clamps in workholding fixtures
real_world.use: The handle drives the link past dead centre so the clamp locks and holds the part with high force.
Demonstration of vertical, horizontal and linear action clamps closing and locking on fixtures.
A foot pump pushes the crossed arms together so the platform rises and stays level.

real_world.product: TMG ALS10 mobile scissor lift table
real_world.use: A hydraulic cylinder drives stacked crossed bars to raise a 2200 lb platform.
A stylus traces a master pattern and the jointed parallelogram arm moves the cutter over the work at a reduced scale.
The pantograph arms copy the tracer path to the cutting spindle at a set ratio.
Two pins slide in crossed grooves so the router rides an exact ellipse.
Two blocks slide in crossed slots and the carried rod's points trace ellipses.
The main rod and crosshead turn the driving wheel while the coupling rod keeps the next wheel in step.
Pacing footage of the running gear, with main and coupling rods driving the wheels at speed.
